item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Quantitative analysis of migration processes and trajectories of territorial and professional mobility (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-07 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Rome
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-01 Economia politica

Activities involving the collection, organization, management, and processing of data related to migratory phenomena and the labor market; construction of territorial and professional mobility indicators; statistical and econometric analysis of the determinants and effects of migration processes, with a particular focus on territorial differences and human capital characteristics; preparation of tables, charts, and empirical results functional to the production of research outputs.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-01 Economia politica

The candidate will be responsible for collecting unstructured data (for example, analyzing large text corpora and digitizing archives) and will apply state-of-the-art quantitative methods to data analysis, under the supervision of the PI. The candidate must also be able to synthesize scientific articles and the results of their own analyses into short reports or presentations in English. Familiarity with AI-assisted coding is desirable. Methodologically, the research sits at the intersection of industrial organization, international trade, and corporate finance, and focuses on the social and environmental responsibility of firms.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Visual Signals in Digital Hospitality Markets: The Impact of Images on the Performance of Peer-to-Peer Accommodation (VIS-HM) (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-07 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-07 Economia e gestione delle imprese

The VIS-HM project investigates the role of visual signals in digital hospitality markets by examining how the characteristics of Airbnb accommodation images influence bookings, occupancy, and revenue. The study considers seven dimensions: colour temperature, human presence, photographic composition, brightness, image quality, visual complexity, and multisensory evocation. Using data from approximately 1,200 private rooms in Rome, subsequently complemented by a comparable sample from Paris, the project combines image analysis with econometric models and machine-learning techniques. The research aims to develop a replicable model, identify the visual signals most strongly associated with…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Mathematical Models for Geopolitical and Cyber Risks (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-04 Metodi matematici dell'economia e delle scienze attuariali e finanziarie

The project defines a unified quantitative framework for the stochastic modeling, financial valuation, and mitigation of emerging risks (geopolitical and cyber). International crisis impacts are formalized using econometric indices (text-mining and new robust indicators) and jump processes, distinguishing between geopolitical threats and events. This framework integrates cyber risk via stochastic processes capturing potential interdependence and cross-contagion between physical and digital domains, aiming at the fair pricing of parametric hedges in incomplete markets and dynamic mitigation via stochastic control. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-15 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-01 Economia politica

The project examines how public opinion forms on specific issues and European integration. Its empirical research will analyze data from sample surveys, questionnaires, and experiments, alongside parliamentary and committee debates, to identify the arguments used and the logical structure of the texts. The Research Appointee will help collect, organize, and analyze quantitative and textual data. Their work will include supporting experiments; analyzing political speeches, editorials, and newspaper articles, including with AI tools; and assisting with statistical and econometric analyses.
